per_candidate.id: s2:The Inhomogeneity Effect. III. Weather Impacts on the Heat Flow of Hot Jupiters, 2023-10-23

rationale: Paper 2512.08932 investigates the heating mechanisms of hot Jupiters, providing evidence that shallow heating plays a significant role in their inflation. This contributes substantive new evidence to part of the question regarding the physical mechanisms behind the large radii of hot Jupiters.
